Works in %1$s, in the phone’s storage, which can’t hold links or start programs directly.
Why
Working in the phone’s storage

Android keeps the phone’s storage for every app, like a memory card. It can’t hold links between files, and it won’t start a program that is stored in it.

So in this folder, install packages with npm install --no-bin-links, and run a script with sh script.sh instead of ./script.sh. Git here ignores file modes. Projects in the app’s own folder have none of these limits.

When Claude Code or Codex starts here, it is told the same.
